subject: x axis label and prediction curve

messages.author: dba8d1ebc846c330
messages.subject: x axis label and prediction curve
parts:
Dear all,

I am preparing a binomial scatter plot in which I want to plot a
prediction curve. I tried to do this with ggplot 2 and I had some
problems with it. The prediction curve is only within the range of the x
values. Is it possible to extrapolate the prediction curve?
Furthermore I would like to use the symbol for square root in the x axis
label. Can someone tell me what is the code for this?

Looking forward to your help.

Kind regards,

Maarten

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: x axis label and prediction curve
parts:
Hi Maarten,
I'm not sure about extrapolating the prediction curve. I think you could do it by hand with predict, assuming the method exists for the model you are using. And then ploting it as another layer.
What I'm sure is that you have to use expression to use the square root symbol. See ?plotmath for more. The code for that is:

#I'm assuming your x axis is of a continous variable, otherwise square-rooting it would make much sense, would it?
p+scale_x_continuous(expression(sqrt("your_var")))

Sorry I couldn't be of more help
Luciano

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: x axis label and prediction curve
parts:
Yes, but you must use paste.
p+scale_x_continuous(expression(paste("Mean of ",sqrt("my_var"), "some other string")))
Luciano
